name: Toy Park
desc: Công viên đường đua đồ chơi, màu tươi và nút nổi
style: TOY PARK variant. A cheerful premium toy amusement-park racing business. Rich sky blue HUD, warm cream cards, saturated orange upgrade buttons and bright grass green earnings. Chunky 3D pictogram icons and softened thick edges. Isometric complete oval/figure-eight circuit on a compact landscaped floating land tile, tiny chibi sports cars, puffy trees, pit garages, a ticket kiosk, small parking lot with marked spaces, grandstands growing in tiers. Rounded tactile cartoon materials with soft daylight and ambient occlusion; restrained detail, make buildings big and iconic rather than realistic. Put a subtle plus/upgrade bubble above ONE facility only. UI has clear spacious rows, modern friendly sans-serif.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high fidelity mobile game UI concept, portrait 390:778 aspect ratio. Input image: STYLE AND LAYOUT REFERENCE ONLY, the earlier Pocket Circuit concept. Create a new distinct variant in the same friendly racing tycoon family, not a copy or simple recolor. Single full-screen edge-to-edge game UI screenshot, no phone device, no collage, no surrounding poster. Preserve layout-review.html information hierarchy: fixed top HUD level12 avatar, cash12.5K, gems240, settings; Rookie Stage3/5 with Facilities button; income +1.25K/min; tilted isometric miniature racetrack with player P3/8 and Lap2/3; below a Car Upgrades section with four compact horizontal rows (icon / name / level and before-after stat / price button); Income section after those; fixed bottom five tabs Race, Bag, Team, League, Shop, with Race active. Track should occupy about 30 percent of screen height and be a readable full miniature loop viewed from above at an angle, enabling the player to see an evolving business. Racecars small like toys, surrounding ticket booth, parking and grandstand facilities all visually part of the circuit economy. Keep large touch targets, readable short English text, cheerful polished rounded casual 3D visual language. Engine Lv8→9 stat46→48 cost3.2K, Tires Lv9→10 stat46→48 cost3.2K, Chassis Lv10→11 cost15K disabled Need2.5K, Gearbox locked UnlockLv15. Income row Tickets Lv8→9 +46→48/min cost3.2K, if room. Clear upgrade action buttons and coin-based progression. The tycoon feeling must come from expanding miniature facilities, collecting revenue, and upgrading, not steering controls. Avoid photorealism, dark esports UI, dense tiny type, excessive scenery blocking UI, dashboard graphs, marketing slogans.

name: Soft Miniature
desc: Mô hình pastel, UI nhẹ và gọn cho idle tycoon
style: SOFT MINIATURE variant. A tasteful soft clay miniature racing tycoon with modern light UI. Powder blue header, ivory-white card surfaces, deep navy typography, coral-orange primary buttons and mint green income accents. Very rounded soft-edged 3D icons with matte clay/plastic material, minimal outlines, quiet subtle shadows. Isometric compact full-loop harbor circuit on an island of mint-green lawn next to pale turquoise water, very simple pastel modular garages, small grandstand and ticket booth, pebble trees and tiny cute racecars. Make the business model legible with a few coin collection bubbles above facilities, never spam. Strong whitespace and consistent minimal components; casual game personality, not enterprise dashboard. Less glossy and much cleaner than reference.

name: Resort Empire
desc: Khu đua ven biển, nhấn mạnh mở rộng cơ sở và doanh thu
style: RESORT EMPIRE variant. Cheerful coastal racing resort business in polished casual 3D. Deep turquoise header/nav, cream panels with subtle aqua borders, sunny golden-yellow action buttons, orange highlights. High-angle isometric full miniature harbor circuit curving through a compact resort-business island. Tiny sports cars, palm clusters, a cute lighthouse, ticket entrance, tiered grandstand, pit building, food kiosk and parking create a racing business park. Present a single small translucent expansion tile with dashed border adjacent to the track and a small plus icon, with no new large UI panel. Revenue bubbles are simple coin icons, few in number. Friendly clean game UI using bold rounded type, simple icons and modest bevels. More economic empire feel than the original close-up race shot; maintain main screen upgrade hierarchy, screen legibility and compact scene.
